resources.string: On the PC, open Glance\'s remote control and show the pairing code. Both must be on the same network.
Point at the code on the PC\'s screen
That is not a Glance pairing code
No answer: off, asleep, or on another network
The PC no longer takes this phone: pair again
The PC keeps running: screens off, lights out, power saving. A touch of the mouse or keyboard ends it.
On. Tap to end it, or touch the mouse or keyboard.
On. Tap to turn them off
Off. Tap to turn them on

Everything on it stops: downloads, remote sessions, whatever is running. It cannot be woken from this phone; press a key or its power button to wake it.\n\nTo leave it running with the screens and lights off, use Night mode.
